title: player
summary: The outbound movement core, jump/fall lifecycle, swimming, drunken movement, heartbeat/facing, teleport/worldport, force speeds, granted movement modes, client-only auto-follow, bare server-authored self corrections, and controlled transport riding are live. Swimming uses the verified 0.75-height threshold and 1/36-yard hysteresis, gravity-free pitched travel, rest-line cap/redirect, server swim speeds, breach jump, START/STOP wire transitions with pitch, and local swim gaits. Drunkenness reads PLAYER_BYTES_3 byte one from the logged-in player, applies Benilla's exact three-harmonic translating-facing pulse with keyboard-turn suppression and fourfold swim-pitch pulse, and deliberately adds no normal-play FOV effect. Self-addressed MSG_MOVE packets hard-snap with the 0x75A07DFF flag merge and rigid facing delta without losing orbit or sending an ack. Stock SMSG_CLIENT_CONTROL_UPDATE revoke/restore statements for the session character now flush and park movement, suppress all local translation/facing authority while the embodied camera and server-spline ride remain attached, then reassert the own mover on restoration. Foreign statements deliberately do not mutate the protected SUI possession/free-view state machine. The dedicated knockback claim was removed as stale against current Benilla. Observed riders compose through live lift/vessel matrices. The controlled mover attaches from owner-aware WMO vessel or M2 lift support, carries position/facing/camera in the transport frame, retains that frame through jumps, streams the exact transport-local ON_TRANSPORT tail, and preserves a ridden vessel/local pose through a transport worldport. Camera distance and pitch now persist per realm-character in the reference two-line, six-decimal format; load seeds requested/effective distance together, while logout, disconnect and app exit atomically save requested distance without yaw. Aura 76 on the session character applies the reference's same-lane misc-value zoom ratio, parks camera and wheel target in first person while held, and restores the configured projection without treating possession or another player's aura as local scope state. PLAYER_FARSIGHT independently moves the rendered, collided and clickable camera eye to the streamed subject's model-derived pivot, votes attach/release on field edges, and leaves movement, residency, minimap, zone and character-centred sound on the player. Ordinary third-person return now uses current Benilla's build-5875 command-word edges, Smart/Always/Never matrices, cosine interpolation, 0.1-2.0 second duration clamp, 0.4-second lazy Track/Fear delay, mouse-look cancellation and far-sight Never override instead of MSUI's old per-frame exponential chase; protected SUI free-view/possession ownership is unchanged. The ground mover now samples the exact rendered four-triangle ADT fan, applies the 50-degree walkability gate to terrain, preserves vertical descent during steep-face shear so jumps cannot bank height, decodes MCNK_IMPASSABLE as one-way chunk entry fences rising from each chunk minimum, and uses current Benilla's one-yard all-or-nothing ledge-step ceiling with body-scale advance. The movement panel and CSV trace expose the terrain normal, steep verdict and authored impassable bit, while focused clinical checks cover walkable/steep slopes, repeated jump contact, one-way fences and low-curb stepping. Current step_probe.rs is dev-only blocked-walk instrumentation and requires no shipped counterpart; world_focus.rs preserves the already-matched rule that world residency follows the session body rather than the remote view subject. The obsolete player/probe_cam.rs and player/probe_look.rs entries were removed after those tools moved under Benilla's capture harness.

openItems.text: ADT terrain was only a post-move scalar height snap, so MaxSlopeDegrees never applied to mountains; WMO wall projection could also write Z into horizontal motion, MCNK_IMPASSABLE was discarded, and the checked-in step ceiling was stale against current Benilla.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-24: TerrainRenderer now returns the exact visible ADT fan height and upward face normal plus MCNK identity. CharacterController applies the 50-degree gate, horizontal-only steep shear and penetration recovery without changing Z, rejects entry to authored impassable chunks while permitting escape and below-terrain tunnels, and uses the verified 1.0-yard atomic step ceiling with fixed 1.1917536-yard certification advance. Movement telemetry exposes the decision, and the focused controller suite passes synthetic 40/55-degree, six-jump, one-way-boundary, below-fence tunnel and curb fixtures.

openItems.text: Owner-run live acceptance: walk ordinary rolling ADT and real stairs/curbs; hold forward and repeat jumps into the verified Elwynn 55-degree face near (-9236.8,-341.9,101.6) and confirm no uphill progress or landing-height gain; then check an authored MCNK_IMPASSABLE boundary blocks entry without trapping a character placed inside. Capture the movement panel/CSV normal, steep and impassable fields.

SMSG_FORCE_*_SPEED_CHANGE is not handled (SMSG_FORCE_RUN_SPEED_CHANGE is only an enum constant): server speed grants (mounts, sprint, slows) neither apply locally nor get acked, which the server treats as an unacknowledged forced change
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: Create-time LIVING speeds seed the controller; all six SMSG_FORCE_* changes update entity and local walk/run/back/turn state and send the mandatory exact counter/pose/speed acknowledgement.

openItems.text: Swimming is entirely absent: no swim state/pitch, MSG_MOVE_START_SWIM/STOP_SWIM are never sent, and the SWIMMING flag never joins the outbound stream
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: CharacterController now owns exact 0.75-height enter and 1/36-yard exit hysteresis, gravity-free pitched swimming, server-seeded forward/back speeds, top-cap redirect and the 9.096748 breach jump. LocalMovementSender emits START/STOP_SWIM, SWIMMING and the pitch tail; CharacterRenderer selects swim animations 41-45. Focused and full clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: Granted movement modes - water walk, feather/safe fall, hover, levitate - are neither applied nor acked nor echoed back in the outbound flag mask (SMSG_MOVE_WATER_WALK/SMSG_MOVE_FEATHER_FALL/SMSG_MOVE_SET_HOVER unhandled)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: Water-walk, feather-fall and hover grants/removals apply persistent controller state, ack exact counters/apply flags, and survive in outbound MovementInfo. Their physical laws are liquid-surface support, 7 yd/s terminal descent and +1 yd ground contact; Levitate composes the three independent grants.

openItems.text: SMSG_MOVE_KNOCK_BACK is not handled - no knockback arc or ack
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23 source re-audit: this is not a current Benilla parity gap. In snapshot b57ee0e9e2c8822b, SMSG_MOVE_KNOCK_BACK/CMSG_MOVE_KNOCK_BACK_ACK exist only in opcode_names.rs; there is no message parser, SessionEvent, dispatch arm, player arc, or ACK writer for the dedicated packet. Benilla comments likewise describe knockback as later server-ride work. No MSUI behavior was invented.

openItems.text: A bare self-addressed MSG_MOVE_* from the server (.go forward-style GM move) is not applied to the local mover
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: ordinary and compressed MSG_MOVE relay dispatch sends the currently controlled mover through ApplyServerAuthoredSelfMove. It hard-snaps position, adopts the shortest facing delta across controller/model/camera while preserving OrbitYaw, merges the reference 0x75A07DFF-authored flags, updates the entity fallback, and sends no ack. Free-view/non-controlled session bodies remain observers. Focused and full clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: Controlled-player transport riding remains incomplete: the ONTRANSPORT pose tail is decoded and observed passengers now compose through live transport matrices, but the controlled mover has no deck-relative input/collision state, no boat-local outbound pose streaming, and no ride-through-worldport handoff.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: Dynamic WMO vessel collision and armed type-11 M2 lift collision are queried in their live owner-keyed transforms instead of being baked into the static BVH. Walkable support attaches the controlled mover to that GUID; each frame rigidly carries position, facing, body and camera before input, retains the platform frame through jumps, and detaches on world ground, swimming, flight, free view or despawn. Every movement/ack snapshot carries ON_TRANSPORT plus the transport-local position/orientation, with an immediate heartbeat on board/deboard. SMSG_TRANSFER_PENDING is retained through NEW_WORLD; a matching ridden vessel is spared across the entity purge, re-armed on the destination map, and the packet's local pose is recomposed before residency/ACK. Focused ElevatorTransport and ControlledTransport checks and the full interface suite pass; the client build has only the three known unrelated warnings.

openItems.text: Live-verify boarding, walking, turning and jumping on moving boat/zeppelin decks and type-11 lift cars; rigid body/camera carry; ON_TRANSPORT local-pose heartbeats and forced-speed acknowledgements; clean deboard to world ground/water; no ghost collider at an old hull/keyframe pose; and uninterrupted vessel ride/camera/position through both continent worldport seams.

Live-verify .go forward/up/relative and an anticheat heartbeat correction: the own avatar should snap immediately, retain camera orbit by the same facing delta, emit no special ack, and continue naturally from the adopted pose. Repeat while free-viewing and possessing so the camera/controlled bot are not pulled to the session character.

Live-verify wade-to-swim hysteresis, idle depth hold, pitched forward ascent/descent, surface cap and level redirect, backward/strafe speeds, swim-idle and 42-45 directional gaits, deep and surface Space breach without held-key refire, START/STOP packets, server swim-speed changes, shore exit and lava/slime surfaces.
CMSG_STANDSTATECHANGE (sit/stand) and CMSG_MOUNTSPECIAL_ANIM are never sent
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: implemented exact stand-state sending/local descriptor poses plus the idle grounded mounted Jump diversion, empty mount-special send, local AnimationData 94 and observer SMSG playback.

openItems.text: The drunk system (DRUNKENSTATE screen effect/gait) has no counterpart
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: implemented current Benilla's actual visible drunken behavior, correcting the stale screen-effect wording. PLAYER_BYTES_3 byte one is clamped/scaled, and the exact bit-pattern three-harmonic cosine pulse veers translating facing unless a keyboard turn is held and perturbs translating swim pitch by 4x. State belongs to the logged-in player during possession. Per Benilla decision 1018, normal play deliberately has no FOV effect. Focused and full clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: Live-verify low/full drunkenness while walking, strafing, deliberately keyboard-turning and swimming: the session character should meander only while translating, keyboard turns should stay crisp, drunk swimming should porpoise, possession should still source the session player's drunk byte, and there should be no visible FOV distortion.

MSUI does not retain the current third-person zoom and pitch per character, while current Benilla reads cameraDistance/cameraPitch once on world entry and writes them at logout, disconnect and app exit.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: CameraPoseLaw owns the exact two-key order, invariant six-decimal LF body, degree conversion, finite/clamped permissive reader and safe realm-character filename. World entry restores both Distance and EffectiveDistance plus Pitch once per identity; logout, disconnect and app exit atomically save requested Distance and Pitch without yaw. Focused CameraPose and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: SPELL_AURA_FAR_SIGHT (76) on the local player does not produce the client-local locked first-person spyglass zoom; it must remain separate from server PLAYER_FARSIGHT/Bind Sight.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: ScopedViewLaw resolves aura 76 and EffectMiscValue from the same effect lane, rejects zero as restore, and applies the dimensionless misc/90 ratio to MSUI's configured FOV. The runtime reads only the session character, parks requested/effective camera distance at first person every frame, blocks wheel escape while held, and clears only its projection override on removal. Focused ScopedView and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: Live-verify Ornate Spyglass/Longsight: the logged-in character should enter a sixfold, wheel-locked first-person view while aura 76 is present, retain mouse-look, unlock at removal while remaining first-person until wheeled out, and restore the configured normal FOV. Repeat while possessing and near another scoped player to confirm only the session character owns the effect.
PLAYER_FARSIGHT on the session character is ignored: Mind Vision/Sentry Totem cannot move the camera eye to the server-named object or send CMSG_FAR_SIGHT attach/release votes.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: ObjectFields exposes the build-5875 field-712 GUID and the game loop reads it only from the session character. Field edges send exact one-byte CMSG_FAR_SIGHT votes; a streamed subject supplies an attachment-17/bounds-derived camera pivot and camera-collision origin, while unset or unstreamed subjects safely use the body. Controlled movement, UI identity, character-centred sound, zone/minimap and body-centred world residency remain unchanged. Focused ViewSubject and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: Live-verify Mind Vision and Sentry Totem attach/clear: the rendered and clickable camera should orbit the remote subject with collision rooted at its head while the player can still move, and character audio, minimap, zone text and residency remain local. Confirm one CMSG_FAR_SIGHT 1/0 vote per field edge, safe body fallback if the subject is temporarily unstreamed, and possession composition without free-view activation.

SMSG_CLIENT_CONTROL_UPDATE is only an enum constant, so allowMove=0 for the session character does not stop local movement/facing authority during fear, confusion or mind control, and restoration does not reassert the mover claim.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: the packed-GUID/allow byte packet is parsed and classified by both dimensions. A self revoke flushes the active movement flags, parks the sender, stops autorun/follow, suppresses translation, jump and facing authority while retaining camera/body attachment and existing server-spline following. A self restore reasserts CMSG_SET_ACTIVE_MOVER only in ordinary own-character control and unparks. Foreign verdicts cannot mutate the protected SUI possession/free-view model. Focused ClientControlUpdate and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: Live-verify fear, confusion and hostile mind control on the session character: one packed SMSG_CLIENT_CONTROL_UPDATE revoke should flush motion and prevent keyboard/mouse-facing escape while the camera follows the server-driven body and its spline; restoration should claim the own mover and resume input without a snap. Repeat while commanding a bot to confirm self-body updates do not disturb SUI possession/free view.

MSUI unconditionally applied an exponential orbit recenter every moving frame; current Benilla implements vanilla cameraSmoothStyle as an input-edge-owned Smart/Always/Never cosine transition with duration clamps and distinct Track/Fear rows.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: CameraFollowLaw/Controller now own the exact engine enum and dropdown mapping, command bits and priority, edge arming, stopping detection, cosine profile, duration floor/ceiling, tracking selector, mouse-look cancellation and far-sight/free-view composition. Focused and full interface-wire checks pass.

openItems.text: Live-verify left-dragging the camera aside then pressing/releasing W, strafing and keyboard-turning under Smart; idle release under Always; inert offsets under Never; both mouse-look modes cancelling an in-flight return; lazy taxi/fear tracking; far-sight suppression; and no change to SUI free-view or possession camera ownership.
